policy: first-party non-test Rust unsafe findings must be registered with reason and validation gate

repo_level_policy.scope: first-party non-test Rust unsafe findings scanned by validation/tools/unsafe_budget.py

field_contract.file: Repository-relative Rust source path for the unsafe finding; mirror to path for legacy registration compatibility.
field_contract.span: Object describing the source extent, at minimum start_line and end_line; single-line legacy findings may mirror start_line to line.
field_contract.category: One of the repo unsafe taxonomy values.
field_contract.reason: Why unsafe remains necessary, including the invariant or external contract that makes it sound.
field_contract.replacement_or_alternative: Safe Rust replacement, narrower unsafe wrapper, or justification that no practical alternative exists.
field_contract.validation_evidence: Evidence that the unsafe case is covered by checks, tests, scans, or review gates.
field_contract.source_evidence: Code, upstream, FFI, ABI, or generated-input evidence supporting the finding.
field_contract.review_status: Current governance state from the review_status allowed values.

registered_findings.reason: The real-fdb-blob-make Rust replay report compares the returned FdbBlob pointer identity with the input blob address, matching the C observable output return_same_blob for an accepted evidence slice.
registered_findings.replacement_or_alternative: Keep the raw pointer cast inside the bounded L2 replay reporter until the fixture-report ABI observer is replaced by a narrower safe identity wrapper.

registered_findings.reason: The L2 real-fdb-blob-make model mirrors FlashDB struct fdb_blob, whose buf field and value input are C void pointers; accepted evidence binds the observable blob.buf and blob.size behavior.
registered_findings.replacement_or_alternative: Keep the raw pointer fields in this bounded validation slice until a safe ABI wrapper or layout-proven pointer-field model replaces the C void* fixture boundary.
